title: Specify LHR provenance, correction, provisional identity and erasure
requirements:
- Require each item to keep its model/profile, terminology system, version and validation status
- Require lifecycle and verification status for every item
- Add workflows for provisional identity, uncertain matching, merge/unlink events and propagation of corrections
- Distinguish amendment, correction, logical withdrawal and legally required erasure
- Expand provenance to transformation, attestation and all provenance actors
- Separate source data from reconciled or derived views
- For ICD-11, retain source identifiers, release and full expression; validate against declared releases
- Define correction, amendment and entered-in-error workflows
